arguments.code:
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='la-mcco@gmail.com', password='wjhPa4l')['access_token']

# 1) Remove from Spotify song library (released in or before 2021)
library_remove_ids = [317, 280, 17, 185, 310, 61, 175, 226, 85, 264]
print('library_remove_count', len(library_remove_ids))
library_removal_results = []
for sid in library_remove_ids:
    resp = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_library(song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    library_removal_results.append((sid, resp))
    print('removed_library_song', sid, 'resp', resp)

# 2) Remove from all playlists in playlist library (songs released in or before 2021)
# Fetch all playlists in library (all pages)
playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not isinstance(resp, list) or len(resp) == 0:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('playlists_in_library', len(playlists), [p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists])

# Collect unique song ids across all playlists
playlist_song_ids = []
for p in playlists:
    playlist_song_ids.extend(p.get('song_ids', []))
unique_song_ids = sorted(set(playlist_song_ids))
print('unique_playlist_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

# Determine release years for these song ids
song_release_year = {}
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = details.get('release_date')
    year = None
    if rd:
        try:
            year = int(str(rd)[:4])
        except Exception:
            year = None
    song_release_year[sid] = year

# Build per-playlist removal lists
playlist_remove_map = {}
for p in playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    song_ids = p.get('song_ids', [])
    to_remove = [sid for sid in song_ids if song_release_year.get(sid) is not None and song_release_year[sid] <= 2021]
    playlist_remove_map[pid] = to_remove

# Print planned removals per playlist
for p in playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    print('playlist', pid, p.get('title'), 'to_remove_count', len(playlist_remove_map[pid]))

# Perform removals from playlists
playlist_removal_results = []
for p in playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    to_remove = playlist_remove_map[pid]
    for sid in to_remove:
        resp = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
        playlist_removal_results.append((pid, sid, resp))
        print('removed_from_playlist', pid, 'song', sid, 'resp', resp)

print('total_playlist_removals_done', len(playlist_removal_results))
